title: Local Zero Germ, Prime-Side Unit Change, and Intrinsic Grade Invariance

canonical_definitions.grid_zeta: Z_K(s) = tau^{-Ks} * zeta(s), tau = 2*pi, K in A_R
canonical_definitions.local_zero_germ: c_F(rho) = F^{(m)}(rho) / m!, where m = ord_{s=rho}(F)

generic_prefactor_control.setup: F_K(s) = exp(-K*L*(s - s_0)) * F(s) for arbitrary holomorphic F

hadamard_factorization_audit.xi_factorization: xi(s) = exp(A + B*s) * prod_rho E(s / rho)
hadamard_factorization_audit.Xi_K_factorization: Xi_K(s) = exp((A + 0.5*K*L) + (B - K*L)*s) * prod_rho E(s / rho)

logarithmic_derivative_analysis.interpretation_of_K_log_tau: Additive constant baseline reflecting global grid prefactor; does not shift individual prime stations
logarithmic_derivative_analysis.regularized_finite_part: h_{rho, K} = h_rho - K*log(tau) (GRADE_COVARIANT, independent of rho and delta)

prime_side_structural_audit.geometric_station_measure: mu_K^{geom} = sum_n Lambda(n) delta_{log n + K*log(tau)}
prime_side_structural_audit.distinction_from_grid_zeta: Geometric prime measure translates prime stations individually (multiplicative tau^{-Ks} on Laplace transform); grid zeta applies one global unit to overall sum (additive K*log(tau) on log derivative)
prime_side_structural_audit.naive_shifted_euler_product: prod_p (1 - (p*tau^K)^{-s})^{-1} assigns weight tau^{-K*Omega(n)*s}, violating global grade K (FIREWALL_CONFIRMED)
prime_side_structural_audit.explicit_formula_zero_input: Zero locations and multiplicities m_rho via residues, independent of |xi'(rho)|

unit_normalized_germ_analysis.evaluation: hat_c_K(rho) = c_xi(rho) for all K in A_R
unit_normalized_germ_analysis.physical_interpretation: Normalization removes the coordinate unit weight tau^K; detector was measuring unit scaling, not arithmetic inconsistency

translation_unitarity_audit.real_translation_operator: (T_a f)(x) = f(x - a) is unitary on L^2(R, dx)
translation_unitarity_audit.reason: For delta != 0, f_rho grows exponentially as x -> +-infty and does not belong to L^2(R)

epistemic_scoping_correction.scope: Audited structures only; no impossibility theorem claimed

next_theorem: Investigate whether discrete prime-power stations p^k * tau^K in the faithful graded algebra R_tau = Z[tau, tau^-1] impose cross-grade constraints on global trace invariants without passing through local zero derivatives or gauge prefactors.
